module rtlpp_08641 (
    output reg [31:0] next_pc,
    input [31:0] cur_pc,
    input clk,
    input rst
);

    always @(posedge clk)
    begin
        if (rst)
        begin
            next_pc <= 32'd0;
        end
        else
        begin
            next_pc <= cur_pc + 32'd4;
        end
    end

endmodule
